graph.name: OutSystems: Decomposing a Data Monolith for Scale and MultiTenancy
graph.notes:
Data is key to monolith decomposition. This video talks about how data was split across services.    
    The interesting point is their design choice of tiering some of their data and offloading it to cheaper dynamodb from aurora.
    They don't quite go into the details though.
    All encrypted data is pushed straight to secrets manager.
